column1: # Redistribution-notice manifest for the bundled OCR runtime.
# bundle-tesseract.ps1 ships tesseract.exe plus every DLL beside it (50 today),
# enumerated rather than hand-listed so the copy set cannot rot when upstream
# changes its dependencies. The upstream installer supplies notices for two of
# those 51 binaries; this manifest accounts for the rest, and the build REFUSES
# if a shipped binary has no row here or its notice is missing.
# COLUMNS: file <TAB> component <TAB> spdx <TAB> notice <TAB> source <TAB> srcpkg
#   file      exact filename as shipped in resources/tesseract/
#   component upstream project (several files legitimately share one)
#   spdx      SPDX expression. "OR" = we may rely on any listed licence;
#             the notice file carries the text(s) that choice requires.
#   source    upstream the notice text came from
#   srcpkg    where the source for THIS BINARY is published. Every DLL in the
#             installer is an MSYS2 mingw-w64 package build, and MSYS2 publishes
#             both the build recipe (the URL in this column) and a per-version
#             The recipe URL is the durable half: the mirror carries the
#             versions currently packaged, and the pinned Tesseract build
#  - A dependency is never removed to simplify this file. Every component gets
#  - Copyleft components are ordinary rows. The GCC runtime (GPL-3.0 WITH the
#    Runtime Library Exception) and the LGPL libraries are listed exactly like
#    the permissive ones; the source and srcpkg columns answer "where is the
#    source", and for the LGPL rows the relink option is available because each
#    is a separate dynamically loaded DLL.
#  - No GPL object code ships in this tree. libtiff is rebuilt without JBIG
#    support by scripts/build-libtiff-nojbig.ps1 so that libjbig-0.dll
#    (JBIG-KIT, GPL-2.0-or-later) is neither imported nor shipped; the bundler
#    refuses if any shipped binary references it.
#  - Keep sorted by filename so a diff against a fresh `Get-ChildItem` reads
